description.value: A three-storey Best Western hotel in Golden, BC, positioned as a gateway to Yoho and Kootenay National Parks and the Trans-Canada Highway corridor through the Rockies. The hotel features a lobby fireplace, indoor pool, business center, and complimentary breakfast included with every stay. Touring cyclists passing through the Columbia Valley will find it a comfortable full-service base in a town well-placed between major mountain passes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is the Best Western corporate booking page for this property, confirming the address (1024 11th Street N, Golden, BC V0A 1H2) and listing amenity icons including 'free-breakfast' and 'free-high-speed-internet', plus narrative text about an indoor pool, lobby fireplace, and business center. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, wash station, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags. Wi-Fi is confirmed by both the OSM internet_access=wlan tag and the website's 'free-high-speed-internet' listing.
concerns: The website is a corporate Best Western booking portal rather than a property-specific site, so property-level amenity details (bike storage, laundry, etc.) are largely absent from the fetched content.
OSM address uses '11 Street North' while the website shows '11th Street N'; these appear to refer to the same street but the formatting differs slightly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel in Golden with an active booking page; a legitimate accommodation stop for touring cyclists on the Trans-Canada corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Free breakfast is confirmed by the website ('free-breakfast' amenity icon and 'Enjoy a balanced and delicious breakfast with choices for everyone'), though timing and packed-breakfast availability for early-departing cyclists is unconfirmed.

wow_evidence: Best Western corporate booking page ... indoor pool, lobby fireplace, and business center
